title: Bicara Therapeutics Announces Closing of $362 Million Initial Public Offering, Including Full Exercise of Underwriters’ Option to Purchase Additional Shares
description: Bicara Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, has announced the closing of its $362 million initial public offering on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker symbol 'BCAX'.
